cases.sentence: Когда Иисус спустился с ___, за Ним последовало множество людей.
cases.translation: When Jesus came down from the mountain, great multitudes followed him.
cases.explain: The preposition с governs the genitive case here (motion down from).

cases.sentence: И Иисус сказал ___, иди, по твоей вере будет тебе.
cases.translation: And Jesus said to the centurion, go, it will be done for you as you believed.
cases.explain: The verb сказал takes its addressee in the dative case.

cases.sentence: Иисус протянул ___ и прикоснулся к Нему.
cases.translation: Jesus stretched out his hand and touched him.
cases.explain: The transitive verb протянул takes a direct object in the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Он изгнал духов ___ и исцелил всех больных.
cases.translation: He cast out the spirits with a word and healed all who were sick.
cases.explain: The instrumental case expresses the means used ('with a word') without a preposition.

cases.sentence: Многие придут с востока и запада и возлягут с Авраамом, Исааком и Иаковом в небесном ___.
cases.translation: Many will come from the east and west and recline with Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob in the kingdom of heaven.
cases.explain: The preposition в indicating location takes the prepositional case.

cases.sentence: Он прикоснулся к ее руке, и ___ оставил ее.
cases.translation: He touched her hand, and the fever left her.
cases.explain: Жар is the grammatical subject of the verb оставил, so it stands in the nominative case.

reading.ru: Тут к Нему подошел человек больной проказой, поклонился ему и сказал, «Господи, если Ты захочешь, Ты можешь меня очистить».
reading.question: What did the leper ask Jesus?
options: To be made clean, if Jesus was willing
To be forgiven of his sins
reading.correct: To be made clean, if Jesus was willing
reading.explain: The leper says если Ты захочешь, Ты можешь меня очистить (if you are willing, you can make me clean).

reading.ru: Сотник возразил Иисусу, «Господи, я недостоин, чтобы ты вошел под крышу моего дома. Скажи лишь слово, и мой слуга выздоровеет.
reading.question: Why did the centurion say Jesus did not need to enter his house?
options: He believed Jesus could heal with just a word
He was ashamed of his house
He thought Jesus was too busy
He did not believe Jesus could heal
reading.correct: He believed Jesus could heal with just a word
reading.explain: The centurion says Скажи лишь слово, и мой слуга выздоровеет (just say the word and my servant will be healed).

reading.ru: Говорю вам, что многие из других народов придут с востока и запада и возлягут на Перу с Авраамом, Исааком и Иаковом в небесном царстве.
reading.question: What did Jesus say about people from other nations?
options: Many will come from east and west to feast in the kingdom of heaven
Only Israelites will enter the kingdom
They will be turned away at the gate
They will become servants of Israel
reading.correct: Many will come from east and west to feast in the kingdom of heaven
reading.explain: Jesus says many will come с востока и запада and recline in the kingdom of heaven with Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.

reading.ru: Придя в дом Петра, Иисус увидел, что его теща лежит в горячке.
reading.question: What was wrong with Peter's mother-in-law when Jesus arrived?
options: She was lying sick with a fever
reading.correct: She was lying sick with a fever
reading.explain: The text says she лежит в горячке (lies sick with a fever).

reading.ru: Он изгнал духов словом и исцелил всех больных.
reading.question: How did Jesus cast out the evil spirits?
reading.explain: The text says he изгнал духов словом (cast out the spirits with a word).

reading.ru: Иисус ответил, у лисиц есть норы и у птиц небесных гнезда, а сыну человеческому негде и голову преклонить.
reading.question: What did Jesus say about the Son of Man's living situation?
options: He has nowhere to lay his head, unlike foxes and birds
He lives with his disciples permanently
reading.correct: He has nowhere to lay his head, unlike foxes and birds
reading.explain: Jesus contrasts foxes' dens and birds' nests with the Son of Man having negde голову преклонить.

reading.ru: Он встал, запретил ветру и волнам, и наступил полный штиль.
reading.question: What happened after Jesus rebuked the wind and the waves?
reading.explain: The text says наступил полный штиль (a complete calm came) after Jesus rebuked the wind and waves.

reading.ru: Выйдя из людей, демоны вошли в свиней, все стадо бросилось с обрыва в озеро и погибло в воде.
reading.question: What happened to the herd of pigs after the demons entered them?
options: The whole herd rushed down the cliff into the lake and died
The pigs became calm and peaceful
The pigs ran away into the hills
The pigs were sold to another town
reading.correct: The whole herd rushed down the cliff into the lake and died
reading.explain: The text says the herd бросилось с обрыва в озеро и погибло в воде.

reading.ru: Тогда все жители города вышли навстречу Иисусу и, увидев Его, попросили покинуть их края.
reading.question: How did the townspeople react when they saw Jesus after the pigs died?
options: They asked him to leave their region
They begged him to stay forever
They asked him to heal more people
They threw a feast in his honor
reading.correct: They asked him to leave their region
reading.explain: The text says they попросили покинуть их края (asked him to leave their region).
